thread:
Eli (CS): PulseHealth submitted an intake: wants to onboard a 13B clinical summarizer, PHI-safe, HSM-backed keys, and either Dedicated or Private. Renewal in ~60 days, they're price-sensitive. Posting for triage.
June (Solutions): Do they provide model artifacts or want us to host a tuned open model?
Eli (CS): They uploaded artifacts (weights + tokenizer) to our intake bucket and attached a short model card. Says training data is internal clinical notes. Link in ticket.
Arman (Eng): Need to confirm tokenizer format and whether weights are quantized. If not, we'll attempt int8 conversion tests. Also need a small sample prompt set to bench tokenization.
Pri (Security): PHI in training data => require PI/PHI leakage scan, signed DPA, and clear retention policy. Customer requests no external logging and full telemetry disable during pilot.
Marta (CSM): They said they'll convert pilot to Dedicated if we can get them live quickly. Marking as renewal risk-high and will coordinate pricing options.
June (Solutions): Proposed pilot acceptance: p95 latency <1.1s on typical 256-token requests, 200 domain QA samples for quality, and a privacy stress test of 800 targeted prompts. I can assemble prompts.
Arman (Eng): Fast path = Dedicated with customer key wrap. Private (VPC + on-prem HSM) needs infra onboarding and will add ~8-12 business days. Dedicated compatibility tests we can run in ~48 hours once we have artifacts.
Pri (Security): Clarify key handling: do they require keys to remain inside their network? If yes, Dedicated won't work unless we do a gateway. If they allow wrapped keys we can proceed on Dedicated with HSM-wrap. Need their HSM contact and key wrapping metadata.
Eli (CS): I'll ask customer to confirm key handling and to provide a 2-3 sentence token sample and the model card.
Marta (CSM): I'll loop Sales in for renewal/commit options and draft a pilot pricing addendum.
June (Solutions): Example runtime config for pilot (staging):
```
route: "/pulse/summary"
model: "pulse-13b-v1"
persist_kv_cache: false
telemetry: disabled
kms: "customer-wrap"
canary: 10%
```
Arman (Eng): Also need to know if they expect long context (>4096). If so, need to stress memory and KV cache behavior. Please ask.
Pri (Security): Security prerequisites to greenlight pilot: signed DPA, key contact, telemetry disable confirmation, and permission to run the privacy scans. No production without full signoff.
ops-bot: Meeting created: "PulseHealth pilot kickoff"  — scheduled for next Tue 11:00am PT. Invite + staging creds sent.
Eli (CS): Added acceptance checklist to ticket PH-5010: security signoff, tokenizer sample, eval pass (perf + quality + privacy), deploy plan, and renewal conversation.
Marta (CSM): I'll prepare renewal options and share before kickoff.
June (Solutions): I'll build the eval matrix and runbook and share a draft in the ticket tomorrow.
Arman (Eng): Ack — will start compatibility tests once artifacts and tokenizer sample are available.
Pri (Security): Ack on conditional basis.
Eli (CS): Thanks all — I'll update the ticket with the artifact link and customer answers. Follow-ups in PH-5010.
